questions.question: How many artists are in the catalog?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM artists

questions.question: How many albums are there?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM albums

questions.question: How many tracks are in the catalog?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM tracks

questions.question: How many customers do we have?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM customers

questions.question: List every genre name alphabetically.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT name FROM genres ORDER BY name

questions.question: What is the name of the artist with id 1?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT name FROM artists WHERE artist_id = 1

questions.question: List first and last names of customers from India.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT first_name, last_name FROM customers WHERE country = 'India' ORDER BY last_name, first_name

questions.question: List employees whose title is Sales Support Agent.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT first_name, last_name FROM employees WHERE title = 'Sales Support Agent' ORDER BY last_name

questions.question: How many invoices are there?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM invoices

questions.question: What is the unit price of track id 1?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT unit_price FROM tracks WHERE track_id = 1

questions.question: How many albums does Nirvana have?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM albums a JOIN artists r ON a.artist_id = r.artist_id WHERE r.name = 'Nirvana'

questions.question: List track names on the album Nevermind in alphabetical order.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT t.name FROM tracks t JOIN albums a ON t.album_id = a.album_id WHERE a.title = 'Nevermind' ORDER BY t.name

questions.question: How many tracks are there in each genre?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT g.name, COUNT(*) AS n FROM tracks t JOIN genres g ON t.genre_id = g.genre_id GROUP BY g.name ORDER BY g.name

questions.question: Which artist has the most albums?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT r.name FROM albums a JOIN artists r ON a.artist_id = r.artist_id GROUP BY r.name ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, r.name LIMIT 1

questions.question: List each customer last name with their support rep last name.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT c.last_name AS customer_last, e.last_name AS rep_last FROM customers c JOIN employees e ON c.support_rep_id = e.employee_id ORDER BY c.last_name, e.last_name

questions.question: What is the total invoice amount for customer id 1?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(CAST(SUM(total) AS NUMERIC), 2) AS spend FROM invoices WHERE customer_id = 1

questions.question: What is the average invoice total?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(CAST(AVG(total) AS NUMERIC), 2) AS avg_total FROM invoices

questions.question: How many invoices were billed in each country?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT billing_country, COUNT(*) AS n FROM invoices GROUP BY billing_country ORDER BY billing_country

questions.question: List track names longer than 300000 milliseconds, alphabetically.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT name FROM tracks WHERE milliseconds > 300000 ORDER BY name

questions.question: What are the five most expensive tracks by unit price then name?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT name, unit_price FROM tracks ORDER BY unit_price DESC, name LIMIT 5

questions.question: How many invoice line items are there?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM invoice_lines

questions.question: What is the total revenue from all invoices?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(CAST(SUM(total) AS NUMERIC), 2) AS revenue FROM invoices

questions.question: List employees who work in Canada.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT first_name, last_name FROM employees WHERE country = 'Canada' ORDER BY last_name

questions.question: List album titles by Radiohead.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT a.title FROM albums a JOIN artists r ON a.artist_id = r.artist_id WHERE r.name = 'Radiohead' ORDER BY a.title

questions.question: How many customers live in the USA?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM customers WHERE country = 'USA'

questions.question: Who are the top 3 customers by total spend?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT c.first_name, c.last_name, ROUND(CAST(SUM(i.total) AS NUMERIC), 2) AS spend FROM customers c JOIN invoices i ON c.customer_id = i.customer_id GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.first_name, c.last_name ORDER BY spend DESC, c.last_name LIMIT 3

questions.question: What is the revenue per genre from invoice line quantities times unit price?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT g.name, ROUND(CAST(SUM(il.unit_price * il.quantity) AS NUMERIC), 2) AS revenue FROM invoice_lines il JOIN tracks t ON il.track_id = t.track_id JOIN genres g ON t.genre_id = g.genre_id GROUP BY g.name ORDER BY g.name

questions.question: Which artist has the highest sales revenue from invoice lines?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT r.name FROM invoice_lines il JOIN tracks t ON il.track_id = t.track_id JOIN albums a ON t.album_id = a.album_id JOIN artists r ON a.artist_id = r.artist_id GROUP BY r.name ORDER BY SUM(il.unit_price * il.quantity) DESC, r.name LIMIT 1

questions.question: What is the average number of tracks per album?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(CAST(AVG(n) AS NUMERIC), 2) AS avg_tracks FROM (SELECT album_id, COUNT(*) AS n FROM tracks GROUP BY album_id) s

questions.question: Who is the manager of Jane Peacock?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT m.first_name, m.last_name FROM employees e JOIN employees m ON e.reports_to = m.employee_id WHERE e.first_name = 'Jane' AND e.last_name = 'Peacock'

questions.question: How many genres are there?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM genres

questions.question: How many employees work here?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM employees

questions.question: List all artist names alphabetically.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT name FROM artists ORDER BY name

questions.question: List customers from the UK by last name.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT first_name, last_name FROM customers WHERE country = 'UK' ORDER BY last_name

questions.question: How many albums does each artist have?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT r.name, COUNT(*) AS n FROM albums a JOIN artists r ON a.artist_id = r.artist_id GROUP BY r.name ORDER BY r.name

questions.question: List tracks on Abbey Road alphabetically.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT t.name FROM tracks t JOIN albums a ON t.album_id = a.album_id WHERE a.title = 'Abbey Road' ORDER BY t.name

questions.question: What is the total invoice amount for customer id 2?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(CAST(SUM(total) AS NUMERIC), 2) AS spend FROM invoices WHERE customer_id = 2

questions.question: How many invoices are dated in 2023?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM invoices WHERE invoice_date >= '2023-01-01' AND invoice_date < '2024-01-01'

questions.question: Who are the top 5 customers by total spend?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT c.first_name, c.last_name, ROUND(CAST(SUM(i.total) AS NUMERIC), 2) AS spend FROM customers c JOIN invoices i ON c.customer_id = i.customer_id GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.first_name, c.last_name ORDER BY spend DESC, c.last_name LIMIT 5

questions.question: What is total invoice revenue by billing country?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT billing_country, ROUND(CAST(SUM(total) AS NUMERIC), 2) AS revenue FROM invoices GROUP BY billing_country ORDER BY billing_country

questions.question: Which genre has the most tracks?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT g.name FROM tracks t JOIN genres g ON t.genre_id = g.genre_id GROUP BY g.name ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, g.name LIMIT 1

questions.question: List employees who report to Andrew Adams.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT e.first_name, e.last_name FROM employees e JOIN employees m ON e.reports_to = m.employee_id WHERE m.first_name = 'Andrew' AND m.last_name = 'Adams' ORDER BY e.last_name

questions.question: What is the average unit price of all tracks?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(CAST(AVG(unit_price) AS NUMERIC), 2) AS avg_price FROM tracks

questions.question: Which customers have never placed an invoice?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT c.first_name, c.last_name FROM customers c LEFT JOIN invoices i ON c.customer_id = i.customer_id WHERE i.invoice_id IS NULL ORDER BY c.last_name

questions.question: What is the most recent invoice date?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT MAX(invoice_date) AS latest FROM invoices

questions.question: How many units of track id 1 were sold?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(quantity), 0) AS qty FROM invoice_lines WHERE track_id = 1

questions.question: List artists who have no albums.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT r.name FROM artists r LEFT JOIN albums a ON r.artist_id = a.artist_id WHERE a.album_id IS NULL ORDER BY r.name

questions.question: How many customers does each sales support agent support?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT e.first_name, e.last_name, COUNT(*) AS n FROM employees e JOIN customers c ON c.support_rep_id = e.employee_id WHERE e.title = 'Sales Support Agent' GROUP BY e.employee_id, e.first_name, e.last_name ORDER BY e.last_name

questions.question: Which album has the most tracks?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT a.title FROM tracks t JOIN albums a ON t.album_id = a.album_id GROUP BY a.album_id, a.title ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, a.title LIMIT 1

questions.question: Which country has the most customers?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT country FROM customers GROUP BY country ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, country LIMIT 1
